mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') AS month , IFNULL( SUM( mete ), 0 ) mete FROM tech_deepen_record WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product_type = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT( create_time , '%Y' ) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%m' ) ORDER BY month
